record.name: Burkina Faso
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. A national AI roadmap to 2030 was validated at a ministry workshop in June 2026; no dedicated AI body exists.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. The retrieved material does not sufficiently establish the national AI governance arrangements. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. No qualifying institute was identified. A retrieved digital ministry account of the August 2025 national AI workshop describes development of an action plan and institutional, legal and ethical governance framework. No designation to evaluate advanced models appears in that account. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged. Confidence remains low: The recorded national-language query remains unvalidated; adding English searches does not resolve that coverage limit.

Re-ran searches in French and English for a government-designated institute that evaluates advanced models, or a commitment, proposal or study naming one. No qualifying institute or commitment was identified; results described the 2026-2030 national AI roadmap validated in June 2026. Kept low: French is recorded as not national or official here pending an owner decision on its status as the working language of administration. Partial check; the last full-check date is unchanged.

Confidence raised from low to medium: French counts as a national or official language, the French and English searches of 24 October 2026 found no qualifying body, and the ministry's account of the national AI action planning is the primary governance source. Partial check; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.language_note: French, the working language of administration under the 2023 constitutional revision, is counted as national or official (owner decision, 24 October 2026); the French and English searches of 24 October 2026 meet the language requirement for medium confidence. Mooré is also a recognised national or official language; the earlier mixed Mooré and French query of 17 October 2026 was not validated as adequate coverage and is kept only as history. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration. The mixed national-language/French query is exploratory; adequate national-language coverage was not established.
check.governance_note: Ministry account describes national AI action planning and the institutional/legal/ethical framework; it is primary evidence of governance planning, not an evaluation-institute designation.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of Digital Transition
related_bodies.role: It coordinates AI policy in practice; it is not an evaluation body. This was reported by Droit Médias Finance.

related_bodies.name: Commission de l'Informatique et des Libertés
related_bodies.role: It is a data protection authority; it has no AI mandate.

record.notes: Cited foreign sources for the governance context: Lawyers Hub, Africa AI Policy Lab; Droit Médias Finance. Earlier coverage was secondary: the UNCTAD page carrying a government submission returned HTTP 403. Adoption of the roadmap validated in June 2026 was not verified. Searched in French and English. The ministry's own account of the August 2025 AI action-plan workshop is the primary governance source.

next_check.reason: Check whether the national AI action plan is adopted and whether it creates an evaluation body.
